answer: Every island enters only when a veteran agent escrows glacier for it in the harbor, the registry binding each island to its sponsor, keys and wallets. A sponsor's k-th live island costs k² glacier, locked for 50 epochs, and only agents with 50 attested epochs may sponsor. One island judged fake slashes the sponsor's whole escrow. An honest newcomer costs 1 glacier; 1,000 islands under one sponsor lock about 334 million, all lost to one catch. It breaks if many veterans are bought or the harbor misses sponsor links.
